final.description: true once the match is over: the weather it was played in, which no longer changes. false: a forecast, updated as kickoff gets closer.

isDay.description: Daylight at kickoff, for a sun or moon icon.

feelsLikeC.description: At kickoff: the temperature with humidity, wind and sun taken into account.

precipitationChance.description: The highest chance of rain in any hour of the match.

precipitationMm.description: Expected rain from an hour before kickoff to the end of the match.

precipitationBeforeMm.description: Rain in the 24 hours before that.

windGustKph.description: The strongest gust during the match.

hours.description: Hour by hour from kickoff to the end of the match.

source.description: Whose data it is, to credit beside it (Open-Meteo).

description: The weather for one match, from the forecast for its pitch (or venue) location.
